newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tatung unit Chunghwa signs loan.
newsitem.headline: Tatung unit Chunghwa signs loan.

text.p: Chunghwa Picture Tubes (UK) Ltd signed a 125 million pounds sterling dual-currency term loan facility with 14 financial institutions, Citibank's Taipei branch and Citicorp International said on Friday.
The facility, guaranteed by Chunghwa Picture Tubes Ltd, was oversubscribed and increased to 125 million sterling from the original 106.1 million sterling, the arranger said.
The borrower, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Chunghwa Picuture Tubes Ltd, was established to hold its parent's investment in a plant to be built in Mossend, Scotland.
Chunghwa Picture Tubes Ltd, one of the world's largest producer of cathode ray tubes, was 87.5 percent owned by Tatung Co Ltd as of July 1996.
Citicorp International is arranger and agent for the facility.
Toronto-Dominion Bank is co-arranger and lead manager.

The other lead managers are Bank of Scotland, Citibank's Taipei branch, Clydesdale Bank, Deutsche Bank's Taipei Offshore Banking branch, Fuji Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan, Sakura Bank, Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co.
Union Bank of Switzerland is manager.
Royal Bank of Scotland, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi's Taipei branch, Kreditbank and Tokai Bank are co-managers.
